You may use "Hashveld" cards and cards with [Multi-Scale] in your deck. All six elemental mechanics below are enabled.

[Fire Breather] When a card with [Fire Breather] enters your field or drop zone, you may activate its own [Fire Breather] and deal up to 2 damage to your opponent, applying any modifiers. Each eligible entering card provides a separate activation opportunity.

[Bolt Breather] When a card with [Bolt Breather] enters your field or drop zone, you may choose to put the top card of your opponent's deck into their drop zone or have your opponent drop 1 gauge, applying any modifiers. Each eligible entering card provides a separate activation opportunity.

[Lightning Strike] Once per turn per fighter, when your opponent actually loses one or more cards from hand or gauge due to your "Lightning" card effect, put the top card of their deck into their drop zone. One opportunity per qualifying loss event. Effects may increase this shared activation limit or explicitly grant additional activations.

[Water Breather] When a card with [Water Breather] enters your field or drop zone, you may choose to gain 1 life or 1 gauge, applying any modifiers. Each eligible entering card provides a separate activation opportunity.

[Regen] Whenever you gain life, activate the [Regen] abilities of eligible cards on your field. For each activation, gain 1 life. Each eligible card may activate once per original life-gain chain. Regen-generated life cannot start another Regen chain, but can activate other eligible life-gain abilities.

[Earth Breather] When a card with [Earth Breather] enters your field or drop zone, all cards currently on your field with the corresponding stats get Power +1000 and Defense +1000 until end of turn, applying any modifiers. Each eligible entering card provides a separate activation opportunity. Bonuses accumulate and do not apply retroactively to future entrants.

[Updraft] Whenever a "Wind" monster on your field successfully attacks (deals battle damage or destroys a monster by battle), activate [Updraft]. For each activation, draw 1 card. A successful link attack provides one activation per participating Wind monster. Item attacks do not naturally activate Updraft unless explicitly permitted.

[Downdraft] If an effect changes your Updraft into Downdraft, activate [Downdraft] instead each time Updraft would activate. Each activation gives all opposing monsters currently on the field Power -2000 and Defense -2000 until end of turn. Reductions accumulate.

[Blight Breather X] A card with this ability begins the fight with Blight X. When a card with [Blight Breather] enters your field or drop zone, you may choose 1 card on the field and increase its Blight by 1, applying any modifiers. Each eligible entering card provides a separate activation opportunity.

Blight Values: Cards may have Blight regardless of their attributes. A "Blight" monster's base current Critical equals its current Blight, with explicit Critical modifiers applied separately. Blight cannot fall below 0. Increasing Blight does not grant the Blight attribute or the keyword. Permanent Blight follows the physical card through all locations until the fight ends; temporary modifiers expire at their specified time even if moved to another card. Moving Blight conserves the amount moved. Blight damage is only damage explicitly classified as such.

[Vanguard] Dragonic Knight-exclusive abilities. [Counteract] is identical to [Counter] [Act]; use only within a legal response window and the ability's printed conditions.

[Royal Decree] You may only activate a [Royal Decree] ability during your seventh individual turn's Main Phase, once per fight.

[Multi-Scale] Cards with [Multi-Scale] may be included regardless of their elemental attributes.
